wdm-alias-sdk.summary: Published npm package surface of the deprecated alias (main: dist/index.js, devMain: src/index.js): the default export Device and the named exports config, constants, DeviceUrlInterceptor, FeatureCollection, FeatureModel, and FeaturesModel, all re-exported from @webex/internal-plugin-device. Importing it loads the device plugin; it registers no plugin of its own. Internal plugin: semantic versioning is not strictly followed. Per-export detail lives in the owning module spec Public surface.

device-plugin-sdk.source: @webex/internal-plugin-device (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-device/src/docs/README.md, contract device-plugin-sdk in its manifest)
device-plugin-sdk.summary: Device plugin package re-exported by this alias: default Device export, config, constants, CatalogDetails, DeviceRegistrationOptions, DeviceUrlInterceptor, and the feature classes. Its entry module registers the internal plugin device on import.

webex-core-plugin-host.source: @webex/webex-core (workspace package; no module spec, so source was used: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/index.js exports the default WebexCore and registerInternalPlugin, defined in packages/@webex/webex-core/src/webex-core.js)
webex-core-plugin-host.summary: Plugin host consumed by the integration test, which constructs a WebexCore instance to observe webex.internal.device after importing the alias. src/index.js does not import it; the device package calls its registerInternalPlugin.
